objective: Find a genuinely new and useful EMC-specific result, or make an honest bounded scientific decision; do not claim all angles exhausted.
concurrency: Four runtime slots: one integrating lead plus three distinct scientific workers.
baseline: R1-R6 are integrated on main 6bc942c888a60cf0194f8437ecd92e36f2e5568e; reuse unchanged verified analyses and the CSPG4 letter benchmark. TMEM266 standalone shelved.

clinical_linkage.question: Do public patient-level EMC cohorts link authenticated NR4A3 fusion partner or molecular subtype to a clinically meaningful course or treatment outcome beyond what the original authors and prior R1-R6 analyses established?
clinical_linkage.potential_value: A robust subtype-to-outcome or treatment interaction could change stratification or next study design; a duplicated cohort or aggregate sarcoma result cannot.
clinical_linkage.first_gate: Find original cohort data tables/case-level published values and overlap crosswalks before modelling. Check existing Mayo, IMMUNOSARC and imaging/trial work; do not repeat it.
clinical_linkage.defeat: No public individual EMC subtype-to-outcome mapping with enough independent donors and a nontrivial unanswered comparison; stop without fabricating a paper.

fusion_transcripts.question: Do direct RNA measurements in authenticated EMC tumors show a recurrent, fusion-partner-related NR4A3 transcript or isoform state not established in the original studies?
fusion_transcripts.potential_value: A reproducible endogenous transcript difference could change which disease mechanism or measurement a researcher tests next; assay or index artifacts and a single sample cannot.
fusion_transcripts.first_gate: Locate source-level specimen, fusion-partner, assay and expression/junction mappings beyond the repository's prior tissue and ASO analyses. Use processed data first; avoid large FASTQ/BAM downloads unless a decisive question passes identity and value gates.
fusion_transcripts.defeat: Original authors already report the contrast, missing junction resolution or independent partner groups, or no authenticated EMC source; stop or record a precise pending gap.

functional_models.question: Do publicly measured pharmacologic or genetic responses in authenticated EMC PDX, organoid or cell models reveal a reproducible disease-specific vulnerability not already reported?
functional_models.potential_value: A replicated direct response with molecular and tissue context could guide a new experiment; expression, in-silico target lists and disputed model labels cannot.
functional_models.first_gate: Search original model and drug-screen studies/resources since the prior R1-R6 audits, authenticate every model/condition and compare source prior art. Exclude prior ATR compound work and R6 engineered-NR4A3 study unless genuinely new evidence changes the decision.
functional_models.defeat: No independent authenticated EMC model response with appropriate controls and novelty; stop without relabelling other sarcomas or single technical wells as donors.

mandatory_science: Before advancing any claim evaluate every identifiable relevant public EMC specimen, model and condition, including broader studies and published-only measurements. Record evaluated/reused/pending suitable/unsuitable/unavailable separately; preserve unfavorable evidence. Independently assess validity, prior art, novelty and value; pursue contrary checks and choose continue, bounded decisive follow-up or shelve. No full manuscript before a worthwhile finding.
restrictions: Preserve evidence, prior work and ownership. Existing sparse worktrees only. Measure C free space before downloads/artifacts and leave >=10GiB; each lane retained cap8MiB and whole R7 copied/recovery budget64MiB. Daily no computer use06:00-10:00 America/New_York, DST-aware, including UI/screenshots/browser automation/headless tests; check time before each such operation and stop by06:00. Quiet file/API work can continue. No paid sources, outreach, publication/submission, external scientific-record edits or PR. Do not route previous platform-denied FAP-tissue/glycan/structural-genomics/HLA-review material through another worker/tool/session; no CAPTCHA/login/unchanged403 workarounds.
worker_closeout: Freeze exact source/evaluation files with hashes and a terminal process statement; report only decision-relevant findings to lead. Lead integrates and pushes validated checkpoint without force; uncommitted worker files are never called merged.
